steps_en.title: Check Response
steps_en.instruction: Tap the person on the shoulder and shout. Check if they respond.

steps_en.title: Call for Help
steps_en.instruction: Ask someone to call emergency services while you start CPR.

steps_en.title: Position Hands
steps_en.instruction: Place the heel of your hand on the center of the chest.

steps_en.title: Compressions
steps_en.instruction: Push down hard and fast — 100 to 120 compressions per minute, 5-6cm deep.

steps_en.title: Rescue Breaths
steps_en.instruction: After 30 compressions, give 2 rescue breaths if trained to do so.

steps_en.title: Continue
steps_en.instruction: Keep going until emergency help arrives or the person shows signs of life.

title_ur: دم گھٹنے کی صورت میں مدد

steps_en.title: Identify Choking
steps_en.instruction: Look for: cannot speak, coughing weakly, turning blue, clutching throat.

steps_en.title: Encourage Coughing
steps_en.instruction: If the person can cough forcefully, encourage them to keep coughing.

steps_en.title: Back Blows
steps_en.instruction: Give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.

steps_en.title: Abdominal Thrusts
steps_en.instruction: Stand behind, make a fist above navel, give 5 inward-upward thrusts.

steps_en.title: Alternate
steps_en.instruction: Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the object clears.

steps_en.title: Stop the Burning
steps_en.instruction: Remove from heat source. Remove clothing and jewelry near the burn (unless stuck).

steps_en.title: Cool the Burn
steps_en.instruction: Hold under cool (not cold) running water for at least 20 minutes.

steps_en.title: Do NOT
steps_en.instruction: Do not use ice, butter, toothpaste, or any cream on the burn.

steps_en.title: Cover
steps_en.instruction: Cover loosely with a clean non-fluffy material. Cling film works well.

steps_en.title: Seek Help
steps_en.instruction: For burns larger than hand size, burns to face/hands/genitals, or chemical burns — go to hospital immediately.

steps_en.title: Stay Calm
steps_en.instruction: Keep the victim calm and still. Movement speeds up venom spread.

steps_en.title: Do NOT
steps_en.instruction: Do NOT cut, suck, or tourniquet the bite. These make things worse.

steps_en.title: Immobilize
steps_en.instruction: Keep the bitten limb below heart level. Immobilize it like a fracture.

steps_en.title: Remove Constrictors
steps_en.instruction: Remove rings, watches, tight clothing near the bite — swelling will come.

steps_en.title: Get to Hospital
steps_en.instruction: Anti-venom is the only treatment. Get to a hospital with emergency care immediately.

steps_en.title: Ensure Safety
steps_en.instruction: Do not move the victim unless there is immediate danger (fire, traffic). Moving can worsen spinal injuries.

steps_en.title: Call for Help
steps_en.instruction: Press SOS in ResQPK or call 1122. Tell them exact location and number of victims.

steps_en.title: Check Responsiveness
steps_en.instruction: Tap shoulder and shout. Check for breathing. If unconscious and not breathing, begin CPR.

steps_en.title: Control Bleeding
steps_en.instruction: Press firmly on wounds with clean cloth. Maintain pressure. Do not remove cloth if soaked — add more on top.

steps_en.title: Keep Warm
steps_en.instruction: Cover the victim with a jacket or blanket. Shock causes rapid heat loss.

steps_en.title: Do NOT
steps_en.instruction: Do not give water or food. Do not remove helmets unless breathing is blocked. Do not leave victim alone.

steps_ur.title: حفاظت یقینی بنائیں
steps_ur.instruction: جب تک فوری خطرہ نہ ہو (آگ، ٹریفک) مریض کو نہ ہلائیں۔

steps_ur.title: مدد کے لیے کال کریں
steps_ur.instruction: ریسکیو 1122 کو کال کریں اور درست مقام بتائیں۔

steps_ur.title: ہوش کی جانچ کریں
steps_ur.instruction: کندھے پر تھپکی دیں اور آواز دیں۔ اگر بے ہوش ہیں تو سانس چیک کریں۔

steps_ur.title: خون روکیں
steps_ur.instruction: صاف کپڑے سے زخم پر مضبوطی سے دبائیں اور نہ ہٹائیں۔

steps_ur.title: گرم رکھیں
steps_ur.instruction: جیکٹ یا کمبل سے ڈھانپیں۔ صدمے میں جسم جلدی ٹھنڈا ہو جاتا ہے۔

steps_ur.title: نہ کریں
steps_ur.instruction: پانی یا کھانا نہ دیں۔ ہیلمٹ نہ اتاریں جب تک سانس بند نہ ہو۔

steps_en.title: Get Help First
steps_en.instruction: Do not jump in yourself unless trained. Throw a rope, branch, or clothing. Call for help immediately.

steps_en.title: Remove from Water
steps_en.instruction: Once safe, remove victim from water carefully. Support the head and neck.

steps_en.title: Check Breathing
steps_en.instruction: Lay victim on back on firm surface. Tilt head back, lift chin, check for breathing for 10 seconds.

steps_en.title: Start CPR if Needed
steps_en.instruction: If not breathing: give 5 rescue breaths, then 30 chest compressions, then 2 breaths. Continue until help arrives.

steps_en.title: Recovery Position
steps_en.instruction: If breathing but unconscious: roll to recovery position (on their side) to prevent choking on water.

steps_en.title: Treat for Hypothermia
steps_en.instruction: Remove wet clothing. Cover with dry blankets. Keep horizontal — standing can cause cardiac arrest in hypothermic patients.

steps_ur.title: پہلے مدد بلائیں
steps_ur.instruction: خود مت کودیں جب تک تیراکی میں ماہر نہ ہوں۔ رسی یا کوئی چیز پھینکیں۔

steps_ur.title: پانی سے باہر نکالیں
steps_ur.instruction: سر اور گردن کو سہارا دیتے ہوئے احتیاط سے باہر نکالیں۔

steps_ur.title: سانس چیک کریں
steps_ur.instruction: سخت جگہ پر لٹائیں، سر پیچھے جھکائیں اور سانس چیک کریں۔

steps_ur.title: ضرورت پر سی پی آر
steps_ur.instruction: اگر سانس نہیں آ رہا: 5 مصنوعی سانس، پھر 30 دبائو، پھر 2 سانس۔

steps_ur.title: ریکوری پوزیشن
steps_ur.instruction: اگر بے ہوش لیکن سانس آ رہا ہے تو پہلو پر کروٹ دلائیں۔

steps_ur.title: سردی سے بچائیں
steps_ur.instruction: گیلے کپڑے اتاریں اور خشک کمبل اوڑھائیں۔ لیٹا کر رکھیں۔

steps_en.title: Recognize Signs
steps_en.instruction: Sudden collapse, no pulse, not breathing, blue lips or face, unconscious. This is different from a heart attack.

steps_en.title: Call Immediately
steps_en.instruction: Call 1122 NOW. Every minute without CPR reduces survival by 10%.

steps_en.title: Start CPR
steps_en.instruction: Place heel of hand on center of chest. Push hard and fast — 100-120 times per minute, 5-6cm deep. Let chest fully rise after each push.

steps_en.title: Rescue Breaths
steps_en.instruction: After every 30 compressions: tilt head back, seal mouth, give 2 firm breaths. Each breath: 1 second, watch chest rise.

steps_en.title: Use AED If Available
steps_en.instruction: If an Automated Defibrillator is nearby: turn on and follow voice instructions. Do not stop CPR until AED is ready.

steps_en.title: Do Not Stop
steps_en.instruction: Continue CPR until ambulance arrives, victim shows signs of life, or you are physically unable to continue.

steps_ur.title: علامات پہچانیں
steps_ur.instruction: اچانک گر پڑنا، نبض نہ ہونا، سانس نہ آنا، ہونٹ نیلے۔ یہ دل کے دورے سے مختلف ہے۔

steps_ur.title: فوری کال کریں
steps_ur.instruction: ابھی 1122 کو کال کریں۔ ہر منٹ CPR کے بغیر بچاؤ کا امکان 10% کم ہو جاتا ہے۔

steps_ur.title: سی پی آر شروع کریں
steps_ur.instruction: ہتھیلی سینے کے درمیان رکھیں۔ فی منٹ 100-120 بار، 5-6 سینٹی میٹر گہرا دبائیں۔

steps_ur.title: مصنوعی سانس
steps_ur.instruction: 30 دبائو کے بعد سر پیچھے جھکائیں اور 2 مضبوط سانس دیں۔

steps_ur.title: AED استعمال کریں
steps_ur.instruction: اگر قریب میں آٹومیٹک ڈیفبریلیٹر ہو تو آن کریں اور آواز کی ہدایات پر عمل کریں۔

steps_ur.title: مت رکیں
steps_ur.instruction: ایمبولینس آنے تک یا مریض کے ہوش میں آنے تک CPR جاری رکھیں۔

steps_en.title: Protect Yourself
steps_en.instruction: If available, wear gloves before touching blood. If not: use plastic bags or extra layers of cloth.

steps_en.title: Apply Direct Pressure
steps_en.instruction: Press firmly on the wound with the cleanest material available. Use your palm. Press HARD for minimum 10 minutes without releasing.

steps_en.title: Do NOT Remove Cloth
steps_en.instruction: If cloth soaks through with blood, DO NOT remove it. Add more cloth on top. Removing disturbs the clot forming.

steps_en.title: Elevate if Possible
steps_en.instruction: If the wound is on an arm or leg, raise it above heart level to slow blood flow.

steps_en.title: Tourniquet for Limbs
steps_en.instruction: For life-threatening limb bleeding only: tie a strip of cloth 5cm above wound. Tighten until bleeding stops. Write time applied.

steps_en.title: Keep Patient Still
steps_en.instruction: Movement increases bleeding. Keep patient lying down and calm. Reassure them help is coming.

steps_ur.title: خود کو بچائیں
steps_ur.instruction: ممکن ہو تو دستانے پہنیں۔ نہیں تو کپڑے کی کئی تہیں استعمال کریں۔

steps_ur.title: دبائو ڈالیں
steps_ur.instruction: صاف کپڑے سے زخم پر مضبوطی سے دبائیں۔ 10 منٹ تک نہ ہٹائیں۔

steps_ur.title: کپڑا نہ ہٹائیں
steps_ur.instruction: اگر خون سے بھیگ جائے تو اوپر اور کپڑا ڈالیں، پرانا نہ ہٹائیں۔

steps_ur.title: اوپر اٹھائیں
steps_ur.instruction: اگر بازو یا ٹانگ پر زخم ہے تو دل سے اونچا اٹھائیں۔

steps_ur.title: ٹورنیکیٹ
steps_ur.instruction: صرف جان لیوا خون بہنے پر: زخم سے 5 سینٹی میٹر اوپر مضبوطی سے باندھیں۔ وقت لکھیں۔

steps_ur.title: مریض کو ساکن رکھیں
steps_ur.instruction: حرکت سے خون بڑھتا ہے۔ مریض کو لٹائیں اور دلاسہ دیں۔
